_comment: Walls that already have somebody else's tag on them.
These four were stood on and read off the HUD, facing the wall. Any more you add want
the same treatment -- position AND heading, because the heading is what turns Franklin
KEEP THEM CLOSE. The run is done on a push bike, so a wall out in El Burro is a ten
minute ride each way and turns a short job into a commute.
id       stable key; the run remembers which walls are done by it
zone     GET_NAME_OF_ZONE code, for reference only
gang     whose tag is on it -- decides the marker colour and who turns up
x, y, z  where Franklin stands to paint
heading  which way he faces, square on to the wall
The mission picks four at random, so more entries means a run you can do twice without
